body: can you add a test for a malformed cookie, like in search-insights.js?
this is exported just for the test right?
should we not return undefined here instead?
I'd keep it as undefined in the return, I think the Algolia API will throw if you pass it `null`, but it will be fine on `undefined`, since that doesn't get serialised.

I thought about returning undefined first, but we have this ESlint rule `consistent-return`.
I can override it, would you recommend it in this case?

same here, returning `null` here instead of `undefined` because  ESlint rule `consistent-return`.
The API does not throw (the query is fired and returns 200), but I think you're making a good point on userToken serialization of `null` and I'd rather not pass a userToken in this case.
If you explicitly return `undefined` it should work.
What does "fail" mean in this test? Do you mean "not fail"?
I think this line is not intended.

It is intended. 
All cookies "live" in the same string, which needs to be parsed.
The spirit of this test is to check `getCookie(cookieName_1)` will not fail if `cookieName_2` is malformed: 
- it should not care about other cookie 
- it should not fail if other cookies are malformed.

Should the description of the test be improved?
